Growth.name: Revenue TTM CAGR vs Selected Range
Growth.description: Revenue TTM CAGR measures annualized TTM-vs-TTM revenue growth over the selected Growth range when enough quarterly data is available. It falls back to current TTM versus an annual historical value when yfinance provides too few quarters.

Growth.name: Net Income CAGR vs Selected Range
Growth.description: Net Income CAGR annualizes bottom-line profit growth over the selected Growth range. For financial companies, consistent earnings growth supports the Growth score, while losses or unstable earnings make the metric unavailable.

Growth.name: Share Count CAGR
Growth.description: Share Count CAGR measures annualized change in ordinary shares over the selected Growth range. Positive values indicate dilution; negative values indicate net buybacks.

Growth.name: Adjusted Price Momentum 12-1
Growth.description: Adjusted Price Momentum 12-1 measures adjusted price performance from roughly 13 months ago to 2 months ago. It is a market signal and has a lower weight than business fundamentals.

Growth.name: Revenue Estimates Growth
Growth.description: Revenue Estimates Growth uses structured analyst revenue estimates from yfinance when enough analysts are available. Higher expected growth improves the Growth score.

Growth.name: EPS Estimate Growth
Growth.description: EPS Estimate Growth uses structured analyst earnings estimates from yfinance when enough analysts are available. Higher expected EPS growth improves the Growth score.

Fundamentals.name: Equity to Assets Range Median
Fundamentals.description: Equity to Assets is stockholders equity divided by total assets, shown as the median over the selected Fundamentals range. For financial companies it is a simple capital buffer proxy.

Fundamentals.name: Return on Assets Range Median
Fundamentals.description: Return on Assets is net income divided by total assets, shown as the median over the selected Fundamentals range. It measures how efficiently a financial company turns its asset base into profit.

Fundamentals.name: Return on Equity Range Median
Fundamentals.description: Return on Equity is net income divided by stockholders equity, shown as the median over the selected Fundamentals range. Higher ROE improves the score, but should still be read together with capital levels.

Fundamentals.name: Net Margin Range Median
Fundamentals.description: Net Margin is net income divided by revenue, shown as the median over the selected Fundamentals range. For financial companies it is a broad profitability signal.

Value.name: P/E Ratio vs Selected Range Median
Value.description: P/E Ratio vs Selected Range Median compares the current price-to-earnings ratio with its approximate median over the selected Value range. A lower current P/E than the historical median supports an Underpriced value signal.

Value.name: P/B Ratio vs Selected Range Median
Value.description: P/B Ratio vs Selected Range Median compares the current price-to-book ratio with its approximate median over the selected Value range. For financial companies, price-to-book is often more relevant than EV/EBITDA or price-to-cash-flow.

Value.name: Analyst Price Target
Value.description: Analyst Price Target measures upside from the current stock price to the average analyst price target. It is useful context but weighted lower because analyst targets can be stale or optimistic.

Growth.name: Revenue TTM CAGR vs Selected Range
Growth.description: Revenue TTM CAGR measures annualized TTM-vs-TTM revenue growth over the selected Growth range when enough quarterly data is available. It falls back to current TTM versus an annual historical value when yfinance provides too few quarters.

Growth.name: Net Income CAGR vs Selected Range
Growth.description: Net Income CAGR compares the latest annual net income with net income from the selected Growth range ago and annualizes the result. It measures whether the company is turning revenue into growing bottom-line profit. The metric is missing when the starting or current net income is not positive, because percentage growth through zero is not economically stable.

Growth.name: Cash From Operations CAGR vs Selected Range
Growth.description: Cash From Operations CAGR measures annualized TTM-vs-TTM operating cash flow growth when enough quarterly cash-flow data is available. It falls back to annual cash flow when needed and is missing when endpoints are not positive.

Growth.name: Operating Margin Annual
Growth.description: Operating Margin Annual is operating income divided by revenue for the latest annual period. It shows how much operating profit the company keeps from each dollar of sales before interest and taxes. A higher margin usually means stronger pricing power, better cost control, or a more scalable business model, so it improves the Growth score.

Growth.name: Gross Margin Trend
Growth.description: Gross Margin Trend measures the change in gross margin over the selected Growth range. Expanding gross margin can indicate stronger pricing power or improving unit economics.

Growth.name: Share Count CAGR
Growth.description: Share Count CAGR measures annualized change in ordinary shares over the selected Growth range. Positive values indicate dilution; negative values indicate net buybacks.

Growth.name: Adjusted Price Momentum 12-1
Growth.description: Adjusted Price Momentum 12-1 measures adjusted price performance from roughly 13 months ago to 2 months ago, skipping the most recent month. It is a market momentum signal rather than a fundamental business metric. Positive momentum helps the Growth score, but it has a lower weight so it does not dominate business fundamentals.

Growth.name: Revenue Estimates Growth
Growth.description: Revenue Estimates Growth uses available analyst revenue growth estimate data from yfinance. It is a forward-looking signal for expected sales expansion. Higher expected growth improves the Growth score, but the metric is weighted lower because estimates can change quickly.

Growth.name: EPS Estimate Growth
Growth.description: EPS Estimate Growth uses available analyst earnings growth data from yfinance. It is a forward-looking earnings signal. Higher expected EPS growth improves the Growth score, but the metric is weighted moderately because estimates can change quickly.

Fundamentals.name: Debt to Assets Range Median
Fundamentals.description: Debt to Assets is total debt divided by total assets, shown as the median over the selected Fundamentals range. Lower leverage generally means a safer balance sheet.

Fundamentals.name: Quick Ratio Range Median
Fundamentals.description: Quick Ratio compares liquid assets with current liabilities and is shown as the median over the selected Fundamentals range when statement history is available. Values below 1 can suggest weak immediate liquidity.

Fundamentals.name: CFO to Debt Range Median
Fundamentals.description: CFO to Debt is operating cash flow divided by total debt, shown as the median over the selected Fundamentals range. Debt-free years with positive cash flow receive a capped strong value.

Fundamentals.name: Interest Coverage Range Median
Fundamentals.description: Interest Coverage is operating income divided by interest expense, shown as the median over the selected Fundamentals range. Higher coverage is safer.

Fundamentals.name: Ohlson Distress Estimate (Informational)
Fundamentals.description: Ohlson Distress Estimate is an experimental Ohlson-style signal. It remains visible for context but has zero scoring weight until market-specific calibration and validation are completed.

Fundamentals.name: ROIC Range Median
Fundamentals.description: ROIC estimates after-tax operating profit divided by invested capital and shows the median over the selected Fundamentals range. Higher ROIC suggests stronger capital allocation and business quality.

Fundamentals.name: FCF Margin Range Median
Fundamentals.description: FCF Margin is free cash flow divided by revenue and shows the median over the selected Fundamentals range. Higher values indicate that revenue converts efficiently into discretionary cash.

Fundamentals.name: Accruals Ratio Range Median
Fundamentals.description: Accruals Ratio is net income minus operating cash flow, divided by total assets. Lower values suggest earnings are better supported by cash flow.

Fundamentals.name: Net Debt to EBITDA Range Median
Fundamentals.description: Net Debt to EBITDA compares debt net of cash with EBITDA and shows the median over the selected Fundamentals range. Lower leverage generally improves financial resilience.

Value.name: P/S Ratio vs Selected Range Median
Value.description: P/S Ratio vs Selected Range Median compares the current price-to-sales ratio with its approximate median over the selected Value range. A lower current P/S than the historical median suggests the stock may be cheaper relative to sales, supporting an Underpriced value signal.

Value.name: P/E Ratio vs Selected Range Median
Value.description: P/E Ratio vs Selected Range Median compares the current price-to-earnings ratio with its approximate median over the selected Value range. A lower current P/E than the historical median suggests the stock may be cheaper relative to earnings.

Value.name: EV/EBITDA vs Selected Range Median
Value.description: EV/EBITDA vs Selected Range Median compares current enterprise value to EBITDA with its approximate median over the selected Value range. It evaluates valuation before capital structure effects. Lower than median supports an Underpriced value signal.

Value.name: Price to CFO Per Share vs Selected Range Median
Value.description: Price to CFO Per Share vs Selected Range Median compares current price to operating cash flow with its approximate median over the selected Value range. It checks whether the stock is cheap or expensive relative to cash generated by operations.

Value.name: Free Cash Flow Yield
Value.description: Free Cash Flow Yield is the latest annual free cash flow divided by current market capitalization. Higher values suggest the company generates more free cash flow relative to its market price.

Value.name: Analyst Price Target
Value.description: Analyst Price Target measures upside from the current stock price to the average analyst price target. Higher upside suggests analysts see more room for appreciation. This metric is useful but weighted lower because analyst targets can be stale or revised.

Value.name: Upside Next 12M vs Configured Benchmark
Value.description: Upside Next 12M vs Configured Benchmark compares current analyst upside with a benchmark stored in this config. It is kept visible as context, but its default weight is 0 because it overlaps heavily with Analyst Price Target.
